Our Building Services

Eight services from Michael Tomkins and a team of 8, based in Gloucester and working across Gloucestershire. The team also covers tiling, painting, electrics and plumbing, so one firm can run the whole job.

Call 07592 487841 WhatsApp Us
House ExtensionsSingle and larger rear extensions, building control led, with open plan kitchen diners and roof lanterns. RenovationsPart and full renovations of homes and period buildings, planned and agreed before we start. Loft ConversionsLoft bedrooms with dormers and fitted wardrobes in the eaves, building control led. BathroomsBathrooms ripped out and refitted, with the materials chosen by you before we start. KitchensKitchens designed by the supplier and fitted by us, usually within 1 to 3 weeks. LandscapingGardens landscaped to what you have in mind, with the plan worked out between us. Patios and DrivewaysPatios and driveways laid in the materials and design you choose. RoofingRoof repairs in a day or two and full re-roofs, with you involved in the materials and look.
